2026-07-22.topic: Geopolitics: Truth Behind the Border Satellite Imagery

slides.title: GEOPOLITICAL MYTH EXPOSED
slides.subtitle: Truth Behind the Border Satellite Imagery

slides.title: The Misleading Claim
slides.body: A viral post claims that satellite images show a new troop build-up near the disputed border region. The post has garnered over 2.4 million views, creating high diplomatic tensions. But is it real?
slides.source: Viral social media posts & media accounts

slides.title: OSINT Investigation
slides.body:
Using public satellite archives and geolocation data, we matched the landscape features. The coordinate details reveal:
1. The image is actually from a military training exercise in 2021.
2. The geographic coordinates place it 150km away from the active border line.
3. Reverse image mapping confirms the original publisher.

slides.title: Nyaya Logical Syllogism
slides.syllogism:
Pratijna: The viral border image is misleading.
Hetu: Because it shows coordinate metadata and terrain matching a 2021 exercise.
Udaharana: Any image containing metadata of a past exercise represents historical state, not current build-up.
Upanaya: This image is historical.
Nigamana: Therefore, the claim of current build-up is false.

slides.title: The Final Verdict
slides.body: The narrative of immediate escalation is entirely fabricated. Do not share unverified rumors. Real intelligence requires systematic verification.
